state.question: Identify the building containing this window-lined study space, if you can.
state.answer: The image shows a large, brightly lit study space with many people working on laptops. The space features floor-to-ceiling windows and a modern design with a high ceiling and a striking light fixture. A poster on the wall displays images of a building labeled 'LIBRARY' and includes numbers 1250, 2360, and 1221. The presence of students suggests this is likely a university or college building.
